nodes.label: Noor AI Quran tutor app
nodes.summary: Expo Router React Native app for Quran learning, Islamic guidance chat, voice calling, quizzes, profile settings, and session history.

nodes.label: RootLayout provider shell
nodes.summary: Loads fonts, hides the splash screen, configures React Query, wraps the app in error, safe-area, keyboard, theme, auth, feature, sect, madhhab, model, teacher, and session providers, and declares route stack entries.

nodes.label: AuthProvider
nodes.summary: Supabase-backed authentication context exposing user, token, authentication state, login, signup, logout, and profile update operations.

nodes.label: SessionProvider
nodes.summary: Offline-first per-user lesson session store that persists to AsyncStorage and best-effort syncs sessions, messages, summaries, and quiz scores to backend API routes.

nodes.label: offline-first session sync
nodes.summary: Local writes happen first; cloud writes are fire-and-forget, with remote UUIDs patched in later and pending messages queued until the remote session row exists.

nodes.label: AsyncStorage persisted preferences and sessions
nodes.summary: Client-side persistence layer for sessions, selected AI model, tradition, madhhab, theme, teacher, reading mode, autoplay, and translation preferences.

nodes.label: backend API via apiFetch
nodes.summary: Authenticated application backend used for profile and session CRUD operations.

nodes.label: Supabase auth session
nodes.summary: Supabase auth session source for sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, token bootstrap, and auth state change subscription.

nodes.label: ModelProvider
nodes.summary: Persists selected AI provider and model; changing provider resets the model to that provider's first model.

nodes.label: SectProvider
nodes.summary: Persists broad tradition selection such as Sunni, Shia, Ibadi, or non-denominational plus optional sub-school.

nodes.label: MadhhabProvider
nodes.summary: Persists selected Sunni madhhab from Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, and Hanbali.

nodes.label: TeacherProvider
nodes.summary: Persists the selected AI Quran teacher persona and exposes teacher metadata to lesson screens.

nodes.label: ThemeProvider
nodes.summary: Persists light, dark, or system theme mode and resolves it against the OS color scheme.

nodes.label: IndexRedirect
nodes.summary: Routes authenticated users to mode selection and unauthenticated users to login after auth loading completes.

nodes.label: LoginScreen
nodes.summary: Email/password sign-in UI with validation, password visibility toggle, error reporting, haptic feedback, and navigation to mode selection on success.

nodes.label: SignupScreen
nodes.summary: Account creation UI collecting name, email, password, and learning level before invoking signup and navigating to mode selection.

nodes.label: ModeSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Authenticated mode chooser between Noor AI Scholar guidance and Online Quran Teacher lesson flow.

nodes.label: GuardianScreen
nodes.summary: Noor AI guardian chat with suggestions, streaming responses, madhhab preference modal, voice input, multilingual TTS voice selection, and link into call mode.

nodes.label: CallNoorScreen
nodes.summary: Hands-free voice-call interface that records audio, transcribes it, streams a guardian reply, speaks the reply, supports barge-in, and hangs up cleanly.

nodes.label: Call Noor turn state machine
nodes.summary: Per-turn flow moves through idle, recording, transcribing, thinking, speaking, and back to idle, with tap behavior varying by state.

nodes.label: HomeScreen
nodes.summary: Teacher-mode home tab showing greeting, quote, optional analytics, prayer times, teacher selection, continue learning, reading order choice, and surah list.

nodes.label: LessonScreen
nodes.summary: Ayah-based lesson chat using live Quran data with static fallback, teacher persona, session recording, recitation audio, TTS, ayah navigation, and quiz handoff.

nodes.label: HistoryScreen
nodes.summary: Session history tab that syncs cloud sessions, computes average score, lists sessions, lazy-loads messages, and displays conversation details in a modal.

nodes.label: QuizScreen
nodes.summary: Knowledge-check flow that records selected answers, advances through questions, calculates score percentage, updates current session score, and presents review results.

nodes.label: ProfileScreen
nodes.summary: Profile and settings screen for display name, learning level, AI model, tradition, madhhab, home feature toggles, and logout.

nodes.label: TabLayout
nodes.summary: Authenticated tab navigator for Home, Lesson, and History, using native tabs when liquid glass is available and classic tabs otherwise.

nodes.label: AuthLayout
nodes.summary: Headerless auth stack containing login and signup screens.

nodes.label: streamChat and streamGuardianChat
nodes.summary: Streaming AI service calls used by lesson tutoring and guardian modes, parameterized by user message, history, model identity, and religious preference context.

nodes.label: Quran API hooks
nodes.summary: useSurahList and useAyah provide live surah metadata and ayah content for home and lesson experiences.

nodes.label: AI personalization context
nodes.summary: Selected provider, model, tradition, sub-school, madhhab, teacher persona, and user level are used to tailor AI answers.

nodes.label: voice input and spoken output
nodes.summary: VoiceRecorder, expo-audio, MediaRecorder, transcription endpoint, Expo Speech, and language detection enable speech-to-text and text-to-speech across chat and call surfaces.

nodes.label: light and dark color tokens
nodes.summary: Central light and dark color palettes with Quran-themed green, gold accents, chat bubble colors, semantic destructive colors, borders, surfaces, and shared radius.

nodes.label: KeyboardAwareScrollViewCompat
nodes.summary: Compatibility wrapper that uses plain ScrollView on web and react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardAwareScrollView on native platforms.

nodes.label: standalone static Expo server
nodes.summary: Zero-dependency Node HTTP server for static Expo builds, platform manifests, landing page templating, MIME mapping, base path handling, and path traversal protection.

nodes.label: NotFoundScreen
nodes.summary: Fallback route that displays an error message and links back to the home route.

edges.evidence: RootLayout wraps the app in providers and renders RootLayoutNav.
RootLayout nests AuthProvider around route content.
RootLayout nests SessionProvider inside user preference providers.
AuthProvider calls supabase.auth.getSession, onAuthStateChange, signInWithPassword, signUp, and signOut.
fetchProfile and updateProfile call /api/profile through apiFetch.
File comment states offline-first; startSession, addMessage, updateSummary, and updateSessionScore write AsyncStorage before backend calls.
SessionProvider reads and writes @quran_tutor_sessions keys using AsyncStorage.
SessionProvider calls /api/sessions and /api/sessions/:id/messages for create, patch, list, and message loading.
Messages are queued in pendingMessages when dbId is missing, then flushed after patchSessionDbId receives a Supabase row UUID.
ModelProvider stores @quran_tutor_ai_model with provider and modelId.
SectProvider uses @quran_tutor_sect and @quran_tutor_sect_subschool.
MadhhabProvider reads and writes @quran_tutor_madhhab.
TeacherProvider reads and writes @quran_tutor_teacher.
ThemeProvider reads and writes @quran_tutor_theme.
IndexRedirect reads isAuthenticated and isLoading from useAuth.
Authenticated users receive Redirect href=/mode-select.
LoginScreen invokes login(email.trim(), password).
SignupScreen invokes signup(name.trim(), email.trim(), password, level).
MODES includes guardian route /guardian for The NoorAI Scholar.
MODES includes teacher route /(tabs) for The Online Quran Teacher.
TabLayout redirects to /(auth)/login when auth loading is done and isAuthenticated is false.
GuardianScreen calls streamGuardianChat with message, history, identity, delta callback, and abort signal.
GuardianScreen sends provider, model, sect, subSchool, and madhhab in identity.
GuardianScreen uses VoiceRecorder, detectTtsLanguage, Speech.getAvailableVoicesAsync, and Speech.speak.
Guardian header phone button routes to /call-noor.
CallState union and handleOrbPress switch define idle, recording, transcribing, thinking, and speaking behavior.
CallNoorScreen records native audio or web MediaRecorder blobs, posts to /api/quran/transcribe, and speaks responses with Expo Speech.
CallNoorScreen calls streamGuardianChat after transcription.
LessonScreen starts a session on mount and adds user and assistant messages to the current session.
LessonScreen calls streamChat with message, ayah context, teacherPrompt, history, identity, and delta callback.
LessonScreen calls useSurahList and useAyah and falls back to staticSurahs when live ayah data is absent.
LessonScreen includes teacher.systemPrompt, user level, provider, model, sect, subSchool, and madhhab in tutoring requests.
finishSession stops speech/audio and routes to /quiz.
QuizScreen calls updateSessionScore(currentSession.id, score) after the last question.
HistoryScreen reads sessions, calls syncFromCloud on token presence, and loadSessionMessages for cloud sessions with empty message arrays.
HomeScreen reads sessions to compute lastSession, totalSessions, and average quiz score.
HomeScreen calls useSurahList and displays API surahs, optionally sorted by revelation order.
HomeScreen reads and writes @quran_tutor_reading_mode.
ProfileScreen renders model, sect, madhhab, learning level, and feature toggle controls.
ProfileScreen calls updateProfile and logout from useAuth.
ThemeProvider resolves theme mode; screens use useColors to consume color tokens derived from the theme system.
Component conditionally returns ScrollView on web and KeyboardAwareScrollView on native.
serve.js serves static-build files, manifests, and landing page HTML for the Expo app.
Both use defensive fallback behavior: the server rejects traversal and returns 404/403 while the session sync keeps local data on network failures.
Both are chat experiences that stream AI deltas into assistant bubbles, use suggestions, haptics, abort controllers, scrolling, and spoken replies, but differ in domain context.
NotFoundScreen sets title Oops, tells the user the screen does not exist, and links href=/.
